hero.subtitle: Stop switching between GCP Console, GitHub, and Sentry. Nervum centralizes your cloud infrastructure, repositories, and application errors into a single management view — always in sync, always actionable.

problem.title: The Bookmark Graveyard
problem.subtitle: Your team has 12 browser tabs open before they can answer one question. Context lives in different tools, and every incident starts with a scavenger hunt.

before.title: GCP Console
before.text: Every VM, database, and Cloud Run service lives in a different part of the console. Good luck getting the full picture.

before.title: GitHub, separately
before.text: Open a second tab to see what just got deployed. Cross-reference commits manually. Repeat for every incident.

before.title: Sentry, in another tab
before.text: An error is firing. But which service? Which team? Which commit caused it? Time to open more tabs.

after.title: Your Cloud, here
after.text: Browse Compute VMs, Cloud SQL databases, and Cloud Run services — start, stop, and inspect them without leaving Nervum.

after.title: Your repos, here
after.text: Commits, pull requests, and merges from every connected GitHub repository in a unified activity feed.

after.title: Your errors, here
after.text: Sentry alerts linked to the service and team that owns them. Full context, zero tab-switching.

howItWorks.title: Integrate in minutes
howItWorks.subtitle: Connect your tools once. Manage everything from one place, forever.

connect.text: Link Google Cloud, GitHub, and Sentry via OAuth in under 3 minutes. No agents, no YAML, no SDK to install.

map.text: Nervum builds an interactive map of your environments — services, databases, repos, and team ownership — and keeps it live.

manage.text: Start VMs, review SQL backups, trace a Sentry error to its commit, and check deployment status. All from one tab.

features.title: Everything in one place
features.subtitle: Replace the tabs. Nervum surfaces the data you need from every tool, in one management view.

environmentMaps.title: Environment Maps
environmentMaps.description: Visual, interactive graphs of your services, databases, and Cloud Run revisions — per environment, always current.

activityFeed.title: Unified Activity Feed
activityFeed.description: GitHub commits, PRs, Cloud Build deploys, and Sentry errors. One feed, instead of four open tabs.

gcpManagement.title: GCP Management
gcpManagement.description: Browse and operate Compute VMs, Cloud SQL, and Cloud Run without opening the GCP Console. Start/stop, inspect, audit — right here.

teamOwnership.title: Team Ownership
teamOwnership.description: Assign teams to services and environments. Every engineer knows who owns what — no Slack pinging required.

accessControl.title: Access Control
accessControl.description: Per-environment RBAC. Control who sees which infrastructure. No over-sharing, no under-sharing.

aiAssistant.title: AI Assistant
aiAssistant.description: Ask your stack questions in plain English. The built-in AI knows your environments, repos, and health status.

automation.title: Replace your daily tabs
automation.subtitle: These are the workflows your team runs every day — now without switching tools.

incidentTriage.title: Incident Triage
incidentTriage.description: A Sentry error fires. See the service, the owning team, and the last GitHub commit — without opening a single extra tab.

deployVerification.title: Deploy Verification
deployVerification.description: A Cloud Build job finishes. Confirm which GitHub commit triggered it, which environment it hit, and whether the service is healthy.

preReleaseAudit.title: Pre-Release Audit
preReleaseAudit.description: Before a release: verify Cloud SQL backups, check all VM states, and confirm environment status — from one screen.

who.title: For teams tired of tab management
who.subtitle: Whether you're a solo CTO or a 50-engineer team, Nervum gives you a single management view across your entire software stack.

ctos.title: CTOs & Tech Leads
ctos.text: Stop asking 'which team owns this?' Nervum maps your entire infrastructure with team ownership baked in, so you get answers — not more tabs.

founders.title: Early Founders
founders.text: You don't have a platform team yet. Nervum acts like one. GCP, GitHub, and Sentry centralized in a single view, from day one.

teams.title: Engineering Teams
teams.text: Onboard new developers in hours. Every service, repo, and environment is mapped and searchable — no tribal knowledge needed.

security.title: Enterprise-Grade Security
security.subtitle: Your system data is sensitive. We take security seriously.

socialProof.title: Trusted by engineering teams
socialProof.subtitle: Join forward-thinking companies using Nervum to scale with confidence.
